BM25 filter keeps only pages relevant to the query

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ContentFilterKind, crawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { bm25Query: "rust programming language", bm25Threshold: 0.1, contentFilter: ContentFilterKind.Bm25, maxDepth: 1 };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawl(engine, url);
  console.log(result.pages[0].html);
}

void main();
```
